Notably, there are no calls to `curl`, `wget`, `eval`, or similar dangerous constructs outside of function definitions. The checksums are properly specified and not marked as 'SKIP', indicating expected integrity verification. Even if they were skipped, that alone would not make this step unsafe. No data exfiltration, dynamic code generation, or remote execution mechanisms are present in the top-level scope.

Therefore, sourcing this PKGBUILD for metadata extraction poses no risk of unintended code execution or data leakage.
</details>
